paper.title: Multimodal 3D LUT Generation via StatLUT with Statistical Features for Photorealistic Style Transfer
paper.usage: clean-room spatially agnostic statistics abstraction; no paper code, weights or data

scientific_conclusion: Spatially agnostic colour statistics are exactly invariant to patch shuffling and nearly recover the correct bounded operator in the top three, but they do not identify a unique operator reliably enough under the frozen Top-1 gate. Retain this mechanism only as a future Top-k baseline or auxiliary descriptor, not an authorizing router.
claim_ceiling: Procedural D0 evidence for spatially agnostic statistical identification of bounded explicit colour operators; not real-film, stock, reference-match, calibration, preference, package, capability or product evidence.
